Agents can wait on meaningful compact-state cursors instead of ingesting repeated full snapshots; controller sampling exists only while bounded waiters are active and cancellation never mutates claims, runtimes, or tests.

Legacy tools and full mutation responses remain supported, while compact ownership labels exclude raw MCP session IDs and compact test results preserve the implemented source-attribution qualification.
